name: manuscript_revision_agent_files_init
title: Manuscript Revision Agent Files
description: Scaffold manuscript-revision AGENT file templates into a target directory, with an optional REVISION_TASK.md sidecar for joint manuscript and response-letter drafting

target_dir.description: Directory where the manuscript-revision agent files will be scaffolded

mission.description: Long-term manuscript-revision mission written into AGENT_GOAL.md. Required so the scaffolded contract is internally consistent on first read; the agent cannot edit AGENT_GOAL.md after scaffold without explicit user instruction

objective.description: Concrete in-flight objective written into AGENT_PROGRESS.md. If omitted, the scaffolded AGENT_PROGRESS.md omits the Current Objective section entirely rather than leaving a literal placeholder

revision_mode.description: Controls whether the scaffold includes only the four core AGENT files or also adds REVISION_TASK.md for joint manuscript and response-letter revision work

overwrite.description: If true, existing scaffold files in target_dir are replaced; if false, existing files are skipped
